description: Synthetic sesslint.checks.graph parity (stdlib-only vectors; no session payload text).
known_parity_gaps: Graph check findings use make_finding with fingerprint omitted; Rust returns FINGERPRINT_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE (known gap).
Python str(float), str(list), and str(mapping) for event fields; Rust returns typed errors and does not invent Python repr strings.
Python events.index on an event object inside same_compaction_segment; Rust does not emulate list identity search (PYTHON_EVENT_INDEX_UNREPRESENTABLE gap).
Evidence map lookup with borrowed/reference semantics; Rust treats Borrowed as distinct from missing key (BORROWED_LOOKUP).
Graph counts and indices that do not fit in i64 (COUNT_UNREPRESENTABLE).
Empty-string parent_id is a finding in Python; omitted from required parity vectors.
Self-loop and other cycle findings; omitted (fingerprint gap).
Two heads on one branch (SL007); omitted (fingerprint gap).
